repair: Battle._item_forme_is_eligible resolves canonical native/current base species and the target form. Item forms require both species to match, reject transformed holders, and require Multitype or RKS System for Arceus or Silvally. Primal callback entry is covered by the same guard. Matching uses species instead of nicknames.
